title: logrotate-lite: make test / lint / dist work (bash + Makefile, build fixing)
prompt: This small bash project does not build: `make test`, `make lint` and `make dist` should do what README.md says they do, but they don't work. Find out what is wrong (the Makefile, the scripts, `bin/rotate.sh`, ...) and fix it so that all three targets work, `make dist` can be run repeatedly, and `bin/rotate.sh` behaves exactly as README.md documents. The test cases in `test/cases/` and the helper `test/assert.sh` are correct: do not change them.
